## Summary

- What changed?
- Why is this change needed?

## Scope

- [ ] The PR is focused on one coherent change.
- [ ] Unrelated generated, temporary, or local-only files are excluded.

## Validation

- [ ] TypeScript passes (`npx tsc --noEmit`).
- [ ] ESLint passes (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] Production build / contracts pass where applicable.
- [ ] Browser smoke coverage was considered for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Mobile behavior was checked for user-visible changes.

## Risk / compatibility

Describe migration, persistence, content-integrity, accessibility, performance, or rollback risks. Write `None identified` if none apply.

## Evidence

Add screenshots, measurements, test output, or reproduction notes when they materially help review.
